name: Kasmina, Enigma Sage
oracle_text:
Each other planeswalker you control has the loyalty abilities of Kasmina.
+2: Scry 1.
−X: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it.
−8: Search your library for an instant or sorcery card that shares a color with this planeswalker, exile that card, then shuffle. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost.
blocked_sentences: Each other planeswalker you control has the loyalty abilities of Kasmina.
−X: Create a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token. Put X +1/+1 counters on it.
−8: Search your library for an instant or sorcery card that shares a color with this planeswalker, exile that card, then shuffle. You may cast that card without paying its mana cost.

needs.what: a -X loyalty cost where X is chosen on activation and read by the ability's effects (X +1/+1 counters)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost_keys.loyalty takes only a fixed signed integer; x_value exists but is not wired to loyalty removal

needs.what: a 0/0 green and blue Fractal creature token
needs.why_existing_wont_do: token_ids has no Fractal; the only 0/0 tokens are germ_0_0_b and construct_0_0_c_artifact_buff

needs.what: a static that gives each other planeswalker you control copies of this permanent's loyalty abilities (activated against the other planeswalker's own loyalty)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: grant_ability grants an authored ability spec, not 'the loyalty abilities of <source>'; and the -X ability it would copy is itself inexpressible

needs.what: a search_library selector matching instant/sorcery cards that share a color with the source planeswalker, exiled then castable free
needs.why_existing_wont_do: search_library options include share_subtype and any_color but nothing for sharing a color with the source; low certainty whether a selector key covers it
